#  Keepr – Unified AWS Infrastructure (Serverless Framework)
#
#  Covers all three features in one deploy command:
#    Feature 1 – Zero-Trust Vault       (S3 bucket + IAM)
#    Feature 2 – Link Detonator         (S3 staging bucket + Lambda + IAM)
#    Feature 3 – Ephemeral Chat         (API Gateway WebSocket + Lambda + DynamoDB)
#
#  Deploy:
#    cd keepr-ephemeral-chat-backend
#    serverless deploy --stage prod
#
#  The "resources" section is pure CloudFormation, so every block works
#  exactly the same as a standalone CloudFormation template would.


service: keepr-ephemeral-chat


# CUSTOM  – change these values if you need different names

custom:
  # Feature 1 – Vault
  vaultBucketName: keepr-vault-storage-anshul

  # Feature 2 – Link Detonator
  detonatorBucketName: keepr-detonator-storage
  detonatorFunctionName: KeeprLinkDetonator
  detonatorMemoryMB: 1600       # Chromium needs extra RAM
  detonatorTimeoutSec: 60

  # Feature 3 – Chat (keep original pattern)
  connectionsTable: ${self:service}-connections-${sls:stage}

# PROVIDER

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: ap-south-1

  # WebSocket API for Feature 3
  websocketsApiName: keepr-chat-api
  websocketsApiRouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  environment:
    # Feature 3 – chat Lambda functions need this env var
    CONNECTIONS_TABLE: ${self:custom.connectionsTable}

  # IAM role for the chat Lambda functions
  # This role is ONLY for the three WebSocket Lambda handlers below.
  # The backend server uses the separate KeeprMasterUser / KeeprMasterPolicy.
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        # Feature 3: send messages back over WebSocket
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - "execute-api:ManageConnections"
          Resource:
            - "arn:aws:execute-api:*:*:**/@connections/*"

        # Feature 3: read/write connection records in DynamoDB
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            - dynamodb:Query
            - dynamodb:Scan
          Resource:
            - Fn::GetAtt: [ConnectionsTable, Arn]
            - Fn::Join:
                - "/"
                - - Fn::GetAtt: [ConnectionsTable, Arn]
                  - "index/*"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# FUNCTIONS  –  Feature 3: Ephemeral Chat WebSocket handlers
#               (unchanged from original working setup)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
functions:
  connectionHandler:
    handler: handler.connectionHandler
    events:
      - websocket:
          route: $connect
      - websocket:
          route: $disconnect

  defaultHandler:
    handler: handler.defaultHandler
    events:
      - websocket:
          route: $default

  sendMessageHandler:
    handler: handler.sendMessageHandler
    events:
      - websocket:
          route: sendMessage

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# RESOURCES  –  Pure CloudFormation for Features 1, 2, and 3
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
resources:
  Resources:

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # FEATURE 1 – ZERO-TRUST VAULT
    # S3 bucket that stores AES-256 encrypted user files.
    # Files are only accessible via short-lived pre-signed URLs generated by
    # the Node.js backend (server.ts). No public access ever.
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    VaultBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      Properties:
        BucketName: ${self:custom.vaultBucketName}
        # Block all public access – objects reachable only via pre-signed URLs
        PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
          BlockPublicAcls: true
          BlockPublicPolicy: true
          IgnorePublicAcls: true
          RestrictPublicBuckets: true
        # Encrypt all objects at rest
        BucketEncryption:
          ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
            - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                SSEAlgorithm: AES256
        # CORS – allow pre-signed PUT/GET from local dev servers
        CorsConfiguration:
          CorsRules:
            - AllowedHeaders:
                - "*"
              AllowedMethods:
                - PUT
                - GET
                - POST
                - DELETE
              AllowedOrigins:
                - "http://localhost:3000"
                - "http://localhost:3001"
                - "http://localhost:5173"
                - "https://keepr-app-gold.vercel.app"
                # Add your production domain here once live, e.g.:
                # - "https://keepr.yourdomain.com"
              ExposedHeaders: []
              MaxAge: 3000
        # Auto-expire encrypted blobs after 7 days (adjust as needed)
        LifecycleConfiguration:
          Rules:
            - Id: AutoExpireVaultObjects
              Status: Enabled
              ExpirationInDays: 7

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # FEATURE 2 – LINK DETONATOR
    # NOTE: keepr-detonator-storage bucket was created manually in AWS Console.
    #       It is NOT managed here to avoid conflicts.
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════


    # Execution role for the KeeprLinkDetonator Lambda
    # (separate from the chat Lambda execution role managed by Serverless)
    DetonatorLambdaRole:
      Type: AWS::IAM::Role
      Properties:
        RoleName: KeeprDetonatorLambdaRole
        AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
          Version: "2012-10-17"
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
              Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
        ManagedPolicyArns:
          # Basic CloudWatch Logs write access
          - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        Policies:
          - PolicyName: DetonatorReadStagingBucket
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: "2012-10-17"
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - "s3:GetObject"
                  Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${self:custom.detonatorBucketName}/*"

    # The headless-browser Lambda (Puppeteer/Chromium).
    # Serverless Framework doesn't "own" this function (no events wired to it).
    # The Node.js backend invokes it directly via the AWS SDK:
    #   lambda.invoke({ FunctionName: 'KeeprLinkDetonator', ... })
    # NOTE: Deploy this stack AFTER uploading lambda-detonator.zip to the
    #       DetonatorStagingBucket, or update-stack after uploading the zip.
    DetonatorLambdaFunction:
      Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
      DependsOn:
        - DetonatorLambdaRole
      Properties:
        FunctionName: ${self:custom.detonatorFunctionName}
        Runtime: nodejs20.x
        Role: !GetAtt DetonatorLambdaRole.Arn
        Handler: index.handler
        MemorySize: ${self:custom.detonatorMemoryMB}
        Timeout: ${self:custom.detonatorTimeoutSec}
        Code:
          # This references the zip you uploaded manually (or via CI) above
          S3Bucket: ${self:custom.detonatorBucketName}
          S3Key: lambda-detonator.zip

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # FEATURE 3 – EPHEMERAL CHAT
    # DynamoDB table for live WebSocket connection IDs.
    # This is identical to the original serverless.yml table definition.
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    ConnectionsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:custom.connectionsTable}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: connectionId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: roomId
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: connectionId
            KeyType: HASH
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: RoomIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: roomId
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput:
              ReadCapacityUnits: 5
              WriteCapacityUnits: 5
        BillingMode: PROVISIONED
        ProvisionedThroughput:
          ReadCapacityUnits: 5
          WriteCapacityUnits: 5
        # Auto-expire stale connections (handler sets ttl = now + 3600 s)
        TimeToLiveSpecification:
          AttributeName: ttl
          Enabled: true

    # NOTE: KeeprMasterPolicy and keepr-master-server IAM user were created
    #       manually in AWS Console. Not managed here to avoid conflicts.


  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # OUTPUTS  – printed by `serverless deploy` and visible in CloudFormation
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Outputs:
    VaultBucketName:
      Description: "Set this as AWS_BUCKET_NAME in your .env"
      Value: !Ref VaultBucket

    DetonatorLambdaArn:
      Description: "Set LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME=KeeprLinkDetonator in your .env"
      Value: !GetAtt DetonatorLambdaFunction.Arn

    ChatConnectionsTableName:
      Description: "DynamoDB table for ephemeral chat WebSocket connections"
      Value: !Ref ConnectionsTable

    WebSocketUrl:
      Description: "Paste this as VITE_WEBSOCKET_URL in your .env"
      Value: !Sub "wss://${WebsocketsApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${sls:stage}"
